limitations: Collecting unittest tests imports trusted first-party Python test modules and can execute their top-level code or load_tests hooks.
Exact matches on the lab's own test suite do not validate pytest/unittest collection on external projects.
Static AST candidates may miss inherited or dynamically generated tests and count pytest functions that unittest does not discover.
This is not bug-finding performance evaluation or independent held-out validation.
next_step: Build an isolated, read-only collection fixture and check divergence cases before applying to unknown project code; pre-register a new multi-project bug corpus before scoring.
